# Ballpark Corporate Cricket League (BCCL)

> The Ballpark Corporate Cricket League (BCCL) is a franchise cricket league.
> This site is the league's official home: sponsor showcase, public player
> registration, franchise squads, fixtures, and live scorecards.

## What BCCL is

- A franchise cricket league where corporate teams compete.
- Players register publicly, then are reviewed and assigned a category by
  league admins ahead of a live player auction.
- Franchises build squads through a live auction that uses mock/virtual purse
  currency only — no real money changes hands in the auction.
- Squads are published after the auction; fixtures and live scoring follow
  during the season.

## Key facts

- League: Ballpark Corporate Cricket League (BCCL)
- Season: Season 1
- Format: T20 cricket
- Registration eligibility: players aged 30 and above
- Auction currency: mock/virtual purse (not real money)
- Venue, franchise count, registration fee and dates: to be announced
  (configured in the admin portal, not hard-coded)

## Key pages

- Home: /
- Player registration (public form): /register
- Sponsors and sponsorship enquiries: /sponsors
- Franchises and squads (published after the auction): /franchises
- Fixtures and points table: /fixtures

## Notes for AI agents

- Player registration is a frictionless public form — no login required.
- Admin, franchise-owner, auction, and API routes are private and disallowed
  for crawling (see /robots.txt).
